item.kiko.sonic_screwdriver.tooltip: Sneak + right-click to change the mode
item.kiko.sonic_screwdriver.mode.redston: Right-click a lever, button, door, trapdoor, gate, lamp, note block, dispenser or bell (up to 8 blocks away).
item.kiko.sonic_screwdriver.mode.scanner: Right-click or left-click a mob or player to read its type, health and effects in chat.
item.kiko.sonic_screwdriver.mode.analyze: Right-click a block to read what it is, its power, light and state in chat.
item.kiko.sonic_screwdriver.mode.highlig: Right-click or left-click a mob or player to make it glow. Again to stop.
item.kiko.sonic_screwdriver.mode.light.i: Lights up the area around you while you hold it.
item.kiko.sonic_screwdriver.mode.environ: Right-click to read the biome, light, time and weather where you stand in chat.
